messages:
ashley: quick heads-up — opened a docs PR that updates the migration guide for Dedicated -> Private (networking section) and adds a tiny Rust SDK snippet. want to ship this before Friday. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/2345

netlify-bot: Preview ready: https://preview.netlify.app/redwood-docs/PR-2345 — build succeeded but static image assets show 404s in the preview UI (see screenshot).

leo: can you paste the failing path? i can try to repro locally.

ashley: failing asset path in preview: /assets/migration/diagram.png — in the repo the file lives at docs/assets/migration/diagram.png. Netlify log shows it was not copied to the publish dir. Branch name has a slash (feat/docs/mig-2026) maybe netlify mangled something. attaching the tiny screenshot: https://user-images.example/snip.png

maya: FYI relative vs absolute paths matter for branch previews. if images are referenced with an absolute root `/assets/...` previews can break depending on base_url. suggestion: use relative path like `./assets/migration/diagram.png` or `assets/migration/diagram.png` inside markdown.

sam: tagging reviewers: @leo @maya — can you take a look? target merge window tomorrow 10:00 PT (docs merge slot). if preview looks good and CI green we'll merge then.

leo: i'll run a quick local repro: `mkdocs build && mkdocs serve -a 127.0.0.1:8000` and also `npx netlify-cli dev` to see how netlify mangles the layout.

ashley: pushing a tiny fix to change the markdown image ref to `![diagram](./assets/migration/diagram.png)` and update mkdocs.yml to ensure `docs_dir: docs`. pushing now.

ci-bot: CI started for PR #2345 — checks: lint, mkdocs-build, linkcheck, screenshot-tests.

devex: quick note on the Rust snippet — add a one-line preface about required cargo features and the `blocking` convenience wrapper. include a fenced code sample with a minimal `Cargo.toml` example.

ashley: added the rust note + Cargo example. snippet:
```toml
[dependencies]
redwood-client = { version = "0.3", features = ["blocking"] }
```

and usage:
```rust
use redwood_client::BlockingClient;
let client = BlockingClient::new("$REDWOOD_KEY");
let resp = client.text_generate("hello");
```

netlify-bot: New preview: https://preview.netlify.app/redwood-docs/PR-2345-2 — images load ✅, build passed.

maya: LGTM from docs copy perspective. small nit: in migration section, reorder steps 2 and 3 for clarity.

leo: one nit on the Rust snippet: mention `features = ["blocking"]` explicitly in the snippet (devex already did) — otherwise async users will be confused. otherwise LGTM.

ashley: added the reorder + clarified the rust feature line. pushed. CI rerun.

ci-bot: All checks passed for PR #2345. linkcheck: 0 warnings. mkdocs-build: success.

sam: i'm approving and will merge at the 10:00 PT docs slot if nothing else pops. please add a changelog line under docs/CHANGELOG.md (1 line).

ashley: changelog entry added. merging in the slot. thanks everyone. :tada:

netlify-bot: Deploy to staging preview succeeded.

ashley: merged at 10:02 PT (slightly late) — live in main. thanks for the quick turn. :pray:
